title: The rehearsal is a build simulator
intention: The rehearsal reads a ticket as a build simulator: handed only the ticket's plan steps and a measured list of what exists and what does not, each step answers that it builds or that it stopped and what was missing.
why: The rehearsal exists to find what a builder would have to guess at before the expensive model builds. Measured 2026-10-29 on 7a31059daa23: its prompt was 57,870 chars, of which the ticket was 16,011, and across three passes most gaps were existence doubts (does this file exist?) or wording differences between reads, not missing plan content — the reader was judging fit to the process and guessing at the world. Akien: 'it doesn't need to fit in to our build process it just needs to say i got stopped here or xyz is missing' and 'we should be telling it what exists and what doesn't before hand.' Akien, 2026-10-29, on rereading: "We talked about splitting up tickets into the ticket plan and the ticket log. the ticket becomes nothing but the build plan. that's what makes this work." Measured the same day on 7a31059daa23: the plan is not yet only a plan — its 16 decisions run D1..D11, D6, FIXME 1, FIXME 2, D11, D13, D17 (a gap's answer is appended beside the step it settles, so D11 stands twice), and a hand kick-back to FIXME journals its missing but leaves the ticket's fixme list stale (clearance.py:1126 is the only writer), which reds the FIXME gate at the next BUILDME.
traces_to: Law 1 (the cheapest reader is spent finding what the plan leaves unsaid, not doubting what the machine can measure); Law 3 (existence is measured before the read, not guessed by the reader); the spanning intention CairnCommons/intentions-not-beside-code/I-the-cheapest-reader-proves-a-ticket-before-it-is-built.md; I-a-ticket-is-a-plan-and-a-log.md (the ticket file IS the plan)
how: At cairn/machines/rehearsal: prompt.md opens 'You are a build simulator here to identify what's missing' and judges build steps only, never the process; render() hands the intention, falsifier and the plan steps (the ticket's live decisions; at FIXME, that FIXME's steps) plus a WHAT EXISTS section built before the read by extracting the paths and dotted modules the steps name and measuring each with look(); VOYAGE CRAFT, ALREADY LANDED, the chart packets and the charters leave the render; each node is {step, state: builds|stopped, missing, confidence} keyed by step id; the three-read diff keeps stopped and step-presence gaps and drops assumption_differs; looks_at leaves the schema and the post-read looker retires. The plan reads as one current line per step: a --decide that settles a step rewrites that step's line in place and the replaced text goes to the .log.jsonl; a FIXME's answers are plan steps like any other. The simulator is handed the plan and nothing from the log. Out of scope, each its own ticket: a hand kick-back via emit writing the plan's fixme list (cairn/tools/base, the builder's lane), and narrowing the store charter's 55 plan_fields to plan-only.
falsifier: Done when (measured at PROVED): render('7a31059daa23') carries no '# VOYAGE CRAFT', '# ALREADY LANDED', '# CHART' or '# CHARTER' heading and carries under 5,000 chars beside its '# THE PLAN' block (57,870 in all measured 2026-10-29 before; the plan block alone is 12,993, so 'under 15,000 in all' was a prediction the measurement killed: 16,223 after) ; it carries '# WHAT EXISTS' listing each path and module the steps cite with present/absent as measured; a fixture plan missing a needed fact still yields a 'stopped' gap naming it; schema.json has no looks_at and no assumption_differs. Horizon: the next three tickets rehearsed after PROVED reach clean in at most 3 passes each. Wrong intent if those tickets rehearse dirtier for reasons a builder would also hit — the chart was the plan.

decisions.text: D1 (the /sorted builder_check): A Haiku builder would ask, and the decisions answer: which decisions are plan steps (live, non-superseded, non-scoped; at a FIXME cursor, only those whose step is that 'FIXME <n>' plus the steps they name); what the WHAT EXISTS extractor matches (backticked or bare tokens containing '/' with a file extension or ending '/', and dotted python module names beginning 'cairn.' or 'skills.'), resolved with the existing look() over [repo, commons]; the new node shape ({step, state: builds|stopped, missing, confidence}); which gap kinds survive (stopped, step_absent, unlisted — assumes/assumption_differs/cannot_proceed fold into stopped); what happens to old rehearsal records (read as history, never re-validated); which proofs are rewritten vs retired. Each becomes a D-line at /chart before rehearsal.

context.because: the /sorted builder_check is the question list D2-D12 answer; read as context, never a step

decisions.text: D2: in cairn/machines/rehearsal/schema.json each node's properties become exactly step, state, missing, confidence, all four required; state's enum is ["builds", "stopped"]; missing is a string ("" when the step builds); looks_at, assumption and would_settle leave the schema, and the node's description is rewritten to the new shape (schema.json carries no examples key; measured 2026-10-29).

D3: in cairn/machines/rehearsal/rehearsal.py, STATES = ("builds", "stopped") and GAP_KINDS = ("stopped", "step_absent", "unlisted"); LOOK_KINDS stays (D5 uses it). validate() allows node keys exactly step, state, missing, confidence, each required; missing must be a string, non-empty when state is stopped; the looks_at branch is deleted; the step checks and the every-decision-exactly-once check are unchanged.

D4: gaps(reads, decision_ids=None) loses its looker parameter. It raises kind "stopped" for every node whose state is stopped (its missing texts merged into a 'missing' list), "unlisted" for every 'unlisted: <text>' step (with its missing), and "step_absent" exactly as today. The kinds assumes and assumption_differs leave; cites_a_decision, world_looker and settled_by_world are deleted, and rehearse() builds no looker and writes no settled_by_world. log_reaches reads a gap's step plus its 'missing' texts. __main__.py prints a gap's missing texts where it printed assumption and would_settle.

D5: add def what_exists(texts: list[str], roots) -> list[dict] in rehearsal.py, directly above render(). It extracts, first-seen order, no duplicates: PATHS, matches of r"~?/?[\w.\-+]+(?:/[\w.\-+]+)+/?" whose last segment contains a '.', ends with '/', or that look() finds (an extensionless file such as bin/cairn), with trailing .,;:)'"` stripped; BARE FILES, matches of r"(?<![\w/.\-+~])[\w\-+]+\.(?:py|jsonl|json|md|sh|txt|toml|ya?ml)\b"; and MODULES, matches of r"\b(?:cairn|skills)(?:\.[A-Za-z_]\w*)+". A path is measured with look({"kind": "path", "name": it}, roots). A relative path still absent is then looked for under the directories of the paths that were found (a root-named first segment is read both under the root and beside it, since the repo and its package are both named cairn), and under the existing directory of an absent cited file; a hit is found with "at": <the spelling it was found at>, and its own directory joins the bases until nothing more resolves. A module is measured on its longest dotted prefix of at least two segments that look({"kind": "module"}) finds. Each entry is {"kind", "name", "found": bool}, plus "module": <the found prefix> when that prefix is shorter than the name, plus "at" when found under a base; WHAT EXISTS prints " (at <at>)". Nothing is imported or run. (Measured 2026-10-29 at this ticket's own first rehearsal: a '+' dropped the charter paths, bin/cairn was never listed, and proofs/x.py and bare names beside a cited component read absent.)

D6: render(ticket, *, root=None, repo=None) returns (text, sha256 of the ticket file bytes, ticket path) as today, where text is prompt() + '

# THE PLAN

' + a ```json block holding title, intention, why, how, falsifier, "steps" (each live non-scoped decision as reader_view labels it: {"step": "D<n>", "text": ...}) and "context" (the scoped decisions' labeled texts, only when any) + '

# WHAT EXISTS

' + one line per what_exists entry over the steps' and context's texts with roots [repo, commons(root)]: 'present path <name>' / 'absent path <name>' / 'present module <prefix> (cited as <name>; the rest is a name inside it, not measured)', or '(the steps cite no path or module)' when there are none. Nothing else is handed: no cursor, berths, questions, fixme list or watchme, and no VOYAGE CRAFT, ALREADY LANDED, chart or charter. landed(), voyage_craft(), VOYAGE_CRAFT_PATH, NOT_DONE, _is_record, _RECORD_NAMES and _RECORD_DIRS are deleted, and voyage_craft.md is git rm'd. berths_root leaves render() and rehearse() and the CLI.

D7: decide() at a step 'D<n>' naming a live, unscoped decision n rewrites line n IN PLACE: the old entry is appended whole to the ticket's .log.jsonl (ticket_log.append_log kind "decision_retired", payload {"decision": <old entry>, "rewritten_in_place": true}), then entry n keeps its n and step and takes text=<the line>, by, source "rehearsal", at=<now>, and the plan is written once. It is refused, with nothing written, when n is absent, retired or scoped, or when line n's 'by' differs from --by (retire()'s author rule: another author's line is theirs to rewrite). A step 'FIXME <k>' with a live line at that step is rewritten the same way; a 'FIXME <k>' with none, and any 'unlisted: <text>' step, appends a new line as today. names_as_replaced() and its refusal are deleted, since a D<n> decide is a replacement by construction. --supersedes keeps its meaning: it retires the named lines into the line written.

D8: cairn/machines/rehearsal/prompt.md is rewritten whole. Its first line is exactly "You are a build simulator here to identify what's missing." It tells the reader: it is handed THE PLAN (a ticket's build steps D<n>, plus intention, why, how, falsifier, and context lines it reads but never answers as steps) and WHAT EXISTS (measured on disk before it read; trust it, and never doubt what is present nor assume what is absent). For each step it walks the step as a builder holding only the plan and WHAT EXISTS: state builds if the step can be carried out as written; stopped if it got stopped, with missing naming exactly what: the fact, file, name or choice the plan does not give. It judges build steps only, never whether the plan fits a process. A step that another step settles builds. A step that deletes or removes something WHAT EXISTS lists as absent builds: the state it asks for already holds. One node per step id, each step exactly once; a step the build needs that no D<n> names is 'unlisted: <text>', stopped, with missing naming it. Stopped is a legal and expected answer. The prompt names no looks_at, ALREADY LANDED, VOYAGE CRAFT or chart.

D9: new proof cairn/machines/rehearsal/proofs/test_the_rehearsal_is_a_build_simulator.py, PROVES = {"c9897770efe6": {"all": "the_rehearsal_is_a_build_simulator"}}, over a scratch commons holding one testing-marked ticket and stub readers (no real reader is called). Teeth: (1) the prompt's first line is the D8 instruction, it says stopped is legal, and it names none of looks_at, ALREADY LANDED, VOYAGE CRAFT; (2) render of the fixture carries '# THE PLAN' and '# WHAT EXISTS' and none of '# VOYAGE CRAFT', '# ALREADY LANDED', '# CHART', '# CHARTER', and not the fixture's workflow_and_state text; (3) what_exists marks a present path present, an absent path absent, a root-spelled path ('CairnCommons/tickets/<file>') present and a sibling-spelled one absent, and a dotted name ending in a function inside a present module present with its module prefix, with nothing imported; (4) validate accepts a builds and a stopped node and refuses looks_at, assumption, state cannot_proceed and a stopped node with empty missing, and schema.json's node properties are exactly the four, all required, with the state enum equal to STATES, and GAP_KINDS is exactly (stopped, step_absent, unlisted); (5) gaps over three reads where one read says stopped yields one stopped gap carrying its missing, three builds reads yield none, and no gap kind outside GAP_KINDS appears; (6) decide at D2 leaves exactly one n=2 line holding the new text and one decision_retired log line holding the old text, a different --by is refused with the plan bytes unchanged, and 'FIXME 1' appends then rewrites; (7) over the live corpus, render('7a31059daa23') carries under 5,000 chars beside the '# THE PLAN' block and none of the four old headings (an invariant, not a snapshot) (measured 2026-10-29: render('7a31059daa23') is 16,223 chars, of which the plan block is 12,993 — its steps alone 10,489 — and everything beside the plan 3,230; the bar the old render broke was what rode beside the plan, 45,000+ chars, so the bound is put there; CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09: measurement settles proof questions).

D10: deleted with their validations/<name>.json: proofs/test_the_reader_is_handed_the_voyage_craft.py, proofs/test_the_voyage_craft_states_what_was_measured.py, proofs/test_the_world_settles_what_a_builder_would_look_at.py (its root-name tooth lives on as D9 tooth 3), proofs/test_a_gap_citing_a_carried_decision_is_settled.py. In proofs/test_rehearsal.py the four ALREADY LANDED teeth (render_lists_the_tickets_landed_commits..., a_crossing_record_commit_is_not_listed..., the_prompt_says_landed_work..., landed_work_is_only_what...) are deleted; the prompt/schema tooth and the _node helper speak builds|stopped; proofs/fixtures/live_fire_pass1.json and live_fire_pass4.json are converted in place (builds_as_written becomes builds with missing ""; every other state becomes stopped with missing = the old assumption text, else would_settle; assumption, would_settle and looks_at are dropped) and the replay tooth keeps its claim, gappy first and clean fourth. Every other proof under proofs/ is edited only where it builds an old-shape node or passes berths_root/looker, and each changed proof is resealed with bin/cairn test --seal. Two proofs asserted the append that D7 replaces, and are edited where they did (measured 2026-10-29, both red after D7): test_a_decision_supersedes_in_one_act.py tooth 2 becomes the_996668_shape_rewrites_d4_in_place (the shape it guarded, a line landing BESIDE D4, cannot happen now), and test_a_superseded_decision_is_retired.py tooth 1 decides its corrected line at an 'unlisted:' step so retire() still has a new line to retire into. test_decide_lands_in_its_line.py reads the steps from '# THE PLAN'.

D11: cairn/machines/rehearsal/intention+why.json is rewritten, through the artifact door, where it describes the reader's input (prebuild, chart, voyage craft, landed, looks_at), so that it describes the plan plus WHAT EXISTS and the builds|stopped answer; its falsifier keeps 'the prompt asserts the reader's job, and stopped is a legal answer'. CairnCommons/intentions-not-beside-code/I-the-cheapest-reader-proves-a-ticket-before-it-is-built.md gets a dated 2026-10-29 amendment quoting Akien verbatim ('You are a build simulator here to identify what's missing'; 'we should be telling it what exists and what doesn't before hand'; 'the ticket becomes nothing but the build plan. that's what makes this work.') that replaces 'we hand the agent the prebuild'. The same act runs cairn/tools/intentions_model_compiler/recompile_gate.sh.

D12: regression net and live fire: every proof under cairn/machines/rehearsal/proofs/ runs green twice before PROVEME. After PROVEME, bin/cairn rehearse c9897770efe6 runs once for real under the new render, and its record's meta.rendered_chars and gaps are read into the verdict.
